prompts.home: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a SINGLE exceptionally refined production desktop web app UI screenshot, crisp 1600x1000 landscape, no device mockup, no perspective, no presentation board. NO saturated royal blue, NO purple, NO colored background gradients, NO giant marketing banner, no overly rounded bubbly cards. Beautiful Geist typography, readable 14px body, bold clear 30px titles, purposeful spacing, compact controls with 6px radii, fine polished simple functional icons that echo Rin's square hairclip. Input image is REFERENCE for the EXACT mascot identity only: keep original FULL COLOR cool silver-haired blue-eyed chibi girl with black/ivory coat, square blue hairclip, small glass tablet. Do not grayscale her or redesign her. IP integrated deliberately, not scattered stickers. Anatomy clean. Left navigation 224px white, topbar 56px, right AI chat 340px white. Central working area is spacious, gridded with 28px padding. Interface copy can be English for impeccable typography, show clear real functional UI, no gibberish microcopy. Screen: Projects overview. Left Forma mark is a sophisticated black geometric F with square sky-blue hairclip notch. Workspace switch 'Personal workspace', small search, active Projects, Templates, divider, PROJECTS tree Nexus/Moss/Roam/Vault, each folder collapsible. Bottom Settings, small Rin avatar and 'Design partner'. Topbar 'Workspace / Projects', cloud/check state, notifications, panel toggle. Central heading 'Your projects' with subtitle 'Design. Build. Stay in sync.' Right aligned Import and black '+ New project'. Under header a refined 82px high command field with small colorful Rin portrait, placeholder 'What would you like to build?', suggestion micro-label 'Ask Rin', small sky-blue keycap. NO marketing hero. Compact horizontal row: All projects (4), Favorites, Connected left; Search projects and grid/list right on same line. Exactly four elegant project cards in 2x2 grid, each has beautifully composed ACTUAL mini app UI preview in a soft neutral inset: Nexus clean analytics charts with sky blue, Moss editorial muted green ecommerce, Roam travel mountains, Vault charcoal finance mint charts. Each footer contains small abstract project mark, project name, ellipsis, description, one compact metadata line '1 page / 2 components' and right status. No gigantic metrics KPI cards. Bottom a minimal single-line 'Start from a template' entry. Right Rin chat: avatar header 'Rin / Your design partner', history and plus, context chip 'Workspace'. Center a nicely scaled colorful 150px-tall exact Rin illustration, title 'A little clarity. A lot of possibility.' short two-line helpful text. Four well-designed small task cards in 2x2 grid with black/sky icons and labels: New project, Design system, Create a page, Sync code. Bottom fixed composer professional multiline input 'Tell Rin what you have in mind...' with attachment+, model chip, black send. Subtle line separators, no huge badges, zero visual clutter. Think extremely polished shipped creative software.
